sanad_rah_forosh_kharid.Command: SELECT * FROM (SELECT TOP (100) _InvPreArts.ipart_Key ,  CAST(_InvPreArts.ipart_Date AS nvarchar(50)) AS DocumentDate, COALESCE (_InvPreArts.ipart_Desc, N'') AS DocumentDesc,_Stocks.st_Code AS StoreCode, COALESCE (_Mats.mat_Code, N'') AS ProductCode, COALESCE (_Mats.mat_Name, N'') AS ProductName, COALESCE (SUM(_InvPreTranses.iptr_Amount), 0) AS SumValue, _Stocks.st_Name AS StoreName, COALESCE (_InvCenters.ic_Num, '') AS DocumentCustomerId, COALESCE (_InvCenters.ic_Name, '') AS DocumentCustomerName, COALESCE (_AddressBook.ab_CellPhoneNum, '')  AS DocumentCustomerPhone FROM _AddressBook RIGHT OUTER JOIN _InvCenters ON _AddressBook.ab_SurnameFirm = _InvCenters.ic_Name RIGHT OUTER JOIN _InvPreArts ON _InvCenters.ic_Key = _InvPreArts.ipart_InvCenterKey LEFT OUTER JOIN _Mats INNER JOIN _InvPreTranses ON _Mats.mat_Key = _InvPreTranses.iptr_MatKey ON _InvPreArts.ipart_Key = _InvPreTranses.iptr_InvPreArtKey LEFT OUTER JOIN _Stocks ON _InvPreArts.ipart_StockKey = _Stocks.st_Key WHERE (_InvPreArts.ipart_StockKey IN (6, 24, 27)) GROUP BY _InvPreArts.ipart_Key, _InvPreArts.ipart_Num, _InvPreArts.ipart_Desc, _InvPreArts.ipart_Date, _Mats.mat_Code, _Mats.mat_Name, _Stocks.st_Code, _Stocks.st_Name, _InvCenters.ic_Num, _InvCenters.ic_Name, _AddressBook.ab_CellPhoneNum ) AS [nESTED]
